description: Book one eligible member class or join its waitlist for yourself or a linked child. Use the exact occurrence key from My classes. An explicit booking request or a user-authorized saved task may name the class and participant directly or by a clear rule. Returns an existing seat or waitlist position without changing it. Cannot cancel an RSVP, rebook a previously withdrawn RSVP, or make a payment.

branch_id.description: Club UUID from the member's list_my_subjects result; access is checked for this club.
branch_id.title: Branch Id

child_id.description: Optional linked child's subject_id from list_my_subjects; omit for the signed-in member.
child_id.title: Child Id

occurrence_key.description: Exact class occurrence key returned by the public or member class schedule.
occurrence_key.title: Occurrence Key

name: book_class_rsvp
title: Book a class RSVP
